scripts.deploy:pages: cd workbench && npx -y node@22 ../node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy . --project-name weekly-research-workbench --branch main
scripts.deploy:pages:debug: cd workbench && WRANGLER_LOG=debug WRANGLER_LOG_SANITIZE=false npx -y node@22 ../node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js pages deploy . --project-name weekly-research-workbench --branch main
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:pages
